req.title: Redirect-to rejects invalid status code
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when /redirect-to receives a status_code outside the 300-399 range.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to handler in httpbin/core.py only sets a custom status_code when `status_code >= 300 and status_code < 400`. Outside that range it silently falls back to 302. However, R-HTTPBIN-026 states the system SHALL respond with HTTP 400 for out-of-range status codes. Reading the source carefully: the code does NOT return 400 — it silently ignores invalid codes and returns 302. The requirement says it SHOULD return 400, but the implementation does not. Tests must be written against the REQUIREMENT (expected 400 on invalid input), which means they will catch the mutation where the boundary condition `>= 300 and < 400` is altered. We also test the exact boundary values (299, 300, 399, 400) to catch off-by-one mutations in the comparison operators. We test a valid in-range code (302) as the positive case, an out-of-range code (200) as the negative case, and the exact boundary values (299, 300, 399, 400) as boundary cases. NOTE: Because the actual httpbin source does NOT return 400 (it returns 302 for invalid codes), the negative/boundary tests asserting 400 will fail on the unmodified source — this is intentional per the requirement statement. The positive test (valid 302 in range) will pass on the real source.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_valid_status_code_302
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
status_code=302 is within the valid 300-399 range
expected: Location header is set to http://example.com
trace: R-HTTPBIN-026: valid status_code in range must be accepted and used
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_valid_status_code_302():
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=302')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers.get('Location') == 'http://example.com'

test_redirect_to_valid_status_code_302()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_redirect_to_invalid_status_code_200_returns_400():

    assert r.status_code == 400
